project: Municipal Asset Management and Permitting Software Solution

criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.

Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.

stories.notes: The synced plan.json has no requirements, guardrails, systems or measures, an empty project name, and placeholder dates (every release and due date on 2026-09-20). The page renders those as empty states rather than filling them in.

criteria.text: Given the system is ready for deployment, when the deployment process is initiated, then the system should be operational with core functionalities.
Given the system is deployed, when a core functionality is accessed, then it should perform as expected.
Trust: Given the deployment process, when it completes, then an audit log entry is created with deployment details.

outstanding: Given the system is connected to Tyler Technologies, when I view the budget tracking dashboard, then I should see real-time budget data.
Given the system is disconnected from Tyler Technologies, when I attempt to view the budget tracking dashboard, then I should receive an error message indicating the integration issue.
Trust: All budget tracking actions must be logged in the audit trail.

criteria.text: Given the system is connected to ESRI ArcGIS, when asset data is updated, then GIS layers should reflect these updates.
Given a GIS field value is changed, when I check the system, then it should show the updated value.
Trust: Ensure all GIS transactions are logged for audit.

outstanding: Given a user performs an action, when the action is completed, then an audit log entry is created.
Given an unauthorized action, when attempted, then it is logged with a warning.
Trust: Audit logs are immutable and timestamped.

criteria.text: Given an asset is added to the system, when I view its details, then I should see its lifecycle status.
Given an asset's condition changes, when I update its status, then the system should reflect the new condition.
Trust: Ensure all asset updates are logged for audit.

outstanding: Given the GIS integration, when assets are loaded, then they appear on the map with accurate locations.
Given a map error, when detected, then a notification is sent to the admin.
Trust: Map interactions are logged for audit purposes.

criteria.text: Given asset data is updated, when I check GIS, then the spatial information should be accurate.
Given a synchronization error occurs, when I review logs, then I should see error details.
Trust: Ensure synchronization logs are maintained for audit.

outstanding: Given the permitting module, when a permit application is submitted, then it is received by the system.
Given incomplete application data, when submitted, then an error message is displayed.
Trust: All submissions are logged with timestamps.

criteria.text: Given a code enforcement permit application is submitted, when I review it, then I should be able to approve or reject it.
Given a permit is approved, when I check the system, then it should reflect the approved status.
Trust: Ensure all permit actions are logged for audit.

outstanding: Given a submitted application, when it enters the workflow, then it is routed to the appropriate reviewer.
Given a workflow error, when detected, then an alert is sent to the admin.
Trust: Workflow transitions are logged for audit purposes.

criteria.text: Given I access the public portal, when I submit a permit application, then I should receive a confirmation notification.
Given I schedule an inspection, when I check the portal, then I should see the scheduled date.
Trust: Ensure all public interactions are logged for audit.

outstanding: Given an application status change, when it occurs, then a notification is sent to the applicant.
Given an invalid contact detail, when a notification is attempted, then an error is logged.
Trust: Notification logs are maintained for audit purposes.

criteria.text: Given the system is connected to Caselle, when a billing request is made, then the billing information should be accurately retrieved from Caselle.
Given the system is not connected to Caselle, when a billing request is made, then an error message should be displayed indicating the connection issue.
Trust: All billing transactions must be logged with a timestamp and user ID for audit purposes.

outstanding: Given the system is connected to Oracle Primavera, when I generate an asset performance report, then I should see accurate performance metrics.
Given the system is disconnected from Oracle Primavera, when I attempt to generate an asset performance report, then I should receive an error message indicating the integration issue.
Trust: All asset tracking and reporting actions must be logged in the audit trail.

criteria.text: Given the system is fully developed, when final testing is conducted, then all functionalities should perform as expected.
Given the system is tested, when a user performs acceptance testing, then no critical issues should be found.
Trust: Given the testing phase, when it concludes, then a comprehensive test report is generated.

outstanding: Given the user interface, when a page is loaded, then it is intuitive and responsive.
Given a UI error, when detected, then a notification is sent to the admin.
Trust: UI changes are logged for audit purposes.

criteria.text: Given a user attempts to log in, when the credentials are correct, then access should be granted with enhanced security protocols.
Given a user attempts to log in, when the credentials are incorrect, then access should be denied and an alert should be logged.
Trust: All login attempts must be recorded with IP address and timestamp for security auditing.

outstanding: Given the system has pre-defined reports, when I select a report, then I should see the report data displayed accurately.
Given the system allows ad-hoc report creation, when I create a new report, then I should see the custom report data displayed accurately.
Trust: All report generation actions must be logged in the audit trail.
